text:
DeployBot: deploy v4.2.0 -> prod started. Canary 10%. Observability: multiple routes (embeddings, reranker) showing p95/p99 regressions and increased 502s. Autorevert: ON (thresholds exceeded). Autorevert currently suppressed pending human decision. Please ack and recommend rollback scope.
Cara: ack. This looks multi-route and correlated with kernel flag change in runtime. Not safe to isolate by route.
Malik: agree — isolating will still leave edge cases. Recommend full revert to last stable tag v4.1.7.
EngOps: full revert impact: 5-10m downtime for canary cutover, no DB migrations in this release. We can run the revert command and then rerun canary with patch.
SRE_Tom: prioritize minimal customer impact. If we revert now we avoid prolonged error spikes. I'll approve rollback.
PM_Rita: comms: freeze release notes; prepare customer advisory explaining rollback and ETA for patched rollout. CS_Lucy, prep list for enterprise notify.
CS_Lucy: pulling enterprise list now, will queue advisory for PM review.
Malik: rollback command (ops):
```
# full release revert
redwoodctl release revert --from-version v4.2.0 --to-version v4.1.7 --reason "canary multi-route regression" --execute
```
EngOps: executing revert. I'll request 2FA code from SRE_Tom.
SRE_Tom: providing 2FA. /approve 2fa-xyz123
EngOps: /run redwoodctl release revert --from-version v4.2.0 --to-version v4.1.7 --reason "canary multi-route regression" --execute
DeployBot: action accepted: release revert initiated by EngOps at 3480001128. Expected window: 3-6 minutes.
Cara: monitoring — p95/p99 trending down during rollback, error rate dropping. :thumbsup:
PM_Rita: draft sent to CS_Lucy for approval: "We reverted today's rollout to the previous stable runtime after detecting regressions in canary. No customer data loss. Engineering is investigating root cause and will patch before attempting a new rollout."
CS_Lucy: approved and sent to enterprise list.
SRE_Tom: keeping alerts at high sensitivity for 30m post-revert. If any regressions persist we escalate to postmortem.
EngOps: revert completed at 3480001135. Canary now at stable v4.1.7.
DeployBot: revert success recorded. Events archived under incident/INC-2026-048.
Cara: filing postmortem; assign to runtime team to revert kernel flag change.
Malik: opening revert PR to fully back out the change (repo@commit zyx987).
PM_Rita: re-open release window after fix validation and new canary. Closing thread; move notes to postmortems.
DeployBot: thread closed by EngOps at 3480001140.
